summary: Tested closure without an invoice, Verificare închideri (approve/reopen) and the fiscal invoice gate (backend + UI), using isolated TEST data only. Backend: 30/34 pass, 1 skip. Direct close with no quote, draft, rejected (real API flow), approved and warranty orders all work across all 7 operational statuses. No QC is required to close, and pre_closure_status + closure_quote_rule are stored. facturata orders cannot be changed to any status, closed, reopened, approved or re-invoiced. Approve removes the order from the list and it stays inchisa. Reopen restores pre_closure_status (or the legacy fallback from history), removes the order from the list, and the order can be edited and closed again. RBAC: 403 for mecanic, 401 without a token. Fiscal invoice gate: returns 400 'Factura fiscală necesită un deviz emis și aprobat' with no quote, or a rejected/draft/sent/superseded quote, and creates no invoice. It returns 400 without QC and 400 when the order is not finalizata. It accepts a real flow: generated quote -> approved with signature -> QC passed -> finalizata -> fiscal invoice 200, and the order becomes facturata. UI: every row on /closure-review has a Link href=/work-orders/{id}; clicking it navigates correctly. Every row has approve and reopen buttons. Clicking approve or reopen on TEST rows removes the row; the reopened order shows ÎN LUCRU. Work order detail: an in_lucru order lists 'inchisa' in the status select; facturata and inchisa orders show no status selector. IMPORTANT: real CL-2026-00086 is NOT currently inchisa. It was reopened to 'aprobata' at 2026-10-18T20:21:59Z by andrei.melek@gmail.com (POST /reopen 200 in the backend log, audit 'reopen'), about 4.5 minutes BEFORE this testing session began. My tests never mutated it: snapshot assertions at teardown passed. It is therefore not in the review list. I did not restore it, as instructed (no mutation).

minor.issue: Only status is checked (LOCKED). A work order that has invoice_id but a status other than facturata (e.g. finalizata after data drift) can be closed (200). The rule says invoiced orders must never close. Add `if w.get('invoice_id'): 400`.

The query does not exclude invoice_id, so an inchisa order with invoice_id shows up in the review list, where Aprobă/Redeschide then return 400. Add `'invoice_id': {'$in': [None, '']}` (or $exists False) to the filter.

issues: The title 'Verificare închideri fără deviz aprobat' is misleading: under the new rule every unbilled closure appears, including ones with an approved quote. Suggest 'Verificare închideri nefacturate'.
Button labels are 'Aprobă'/'Redeschide', while the spec says 'Aprobare'/'Redeschidere comandă' (cosmetic).
The 'Aprobare' column is static text 'În așteptare' and adds no information.

critical_code_review_comments: quote_closure_rule is now only used for finalizata. For a draft/sent quote, finalizata returns 'Devizul este în așteptare', which is consistent with the fiscal gate. However, closure_exceptions still recomputes quote_closure_rule for legacy rows, which yields 'deviz_aprobat' -> the UI REASONS map has no entry -> shows '—'
